goals: Verify the GetWorkshop API successfully retrieves the correct details of an existing workshop.
activities: Create a workshop with a specific name.
Create another workshop with a different name.
Construct the API URL for retrieving the first workshop.
Send a GET request to retrieve the workshop by ID.
Verify the HTTP status code is 200.
Verify the status field in the response body is 200.
Verify the message field in the response body indicates success.
Verify the data field in the response body matches the expected workshop details.
Verify the 'detail' field is not present in the response body.
